next_actions: Raise combined life/ES before pushing red maps.
Use belt/boots/gloves/helmet suffixes to improve chaos resistance.
Do not count suppression as a full defensive layer until the total is confirmed near cap.
Reserve rare suffixes on belt/boots/gloves/helmet for resists, attributes, chaos res, or suppression.
Record atlas passive count, voidstones, T16 clear time, and deaths per map before selecting aggressive farming.
